metadata.title: Privacy Policy
metadata.description: How Princeps collects, processes, and protects your personal data.

sections.heading: Data Controller
sections.content: The data controller for the processing of your personal data (as defined under GDPR) is AnotherProject™ – ColdByDefault. For data protection inquiries, please contact: privacy@princeps.app

sections.heading: Data We Collect
sections.content: We collect account information (name, email address, username, password hash), content you create (tasks, meetings, decisions, goals, contacts, chat messages, knowledge documents, memory entries), and technical login data (IP address, timestamps) to protect your account.

sections.heading: Purpose of Processing
sections.content: Your data is processed solely to provide and improve Princeps, for authentication and account security, and for billing on paid plans. We do not share your data with third parties for advertising purposes.

sections.heading: Data Retention
sections.content: Your data is retained as long as your account is active. After account deletion, all personal data is permanently removed within 30 days.

sections.heading: Your Rights (GDPR)
sections.content: You have the right to access (Art. 15), rectification (Art. 16), erasure (Art. 17), restriction of processing (Art. 18), data portability (Art. 20), and objection (Art. 21). You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a competent data protection authority.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.content: For data protection questions, contact us at privacy@princeps.app. We respond to requests in accordance with GDPR within 30 days.

metadata.title: Terms of Use
metadata.description: The rules and conditions for using Princeps.

sections.heading: Scope
sections.content: These Terms of Use apply to all registered users of Princeps. By registering, you agree to these terms.

sections.heading: User Account
sections.content: You are responsible for the security of your account and credentials. Do not share your password with others. Notify us immediately at support@princeps.app if you suspect unauthorized access to your account.

sections.heading: Acceptable Use
sections.content: Princeps may only be used for lawful purposes. Prohibited activities include: unauthorized automated access, reverse engineering, uploading unlawful content, and any use that disrupts the operation of the service.

sections.heading: Limitation of Liability
sections.content: The service is provided 'as is'. We are not liable for data loss, indirect damages, or loss of profits. Liability for gross negligence and intent remains unaffected.

sections.heading: Governing Law
sections.content: These terms are governed by the laws of the Federal Republic of Germany. The place of jurisdiction for all disputes arising from or in connection with these terms is Germany.

sections.heading: Termination
sections.content: You may delete your account at any time via Settings. We reserve the right to suspend or delete accounts in cases of serious violations of these terms.

metadata.title: Cookie Policy
metadata.description: What cookies Princeps uses and how you can control them.

sections.heading: What Are Cookies?
sections.content: Cookies are small text files that your browser stores on your device when you visit a website. They allow us to identify your session and provide the basic functions of the app.

sections.heading: Essential Cookies
sections.content: Princeps uses only technically necessary session cookies required for authentication. These cookies are automatically deleted when you log out or close your browser session.

sections.heading: No Marketing or Analytics Cookies
sections.content: We do not use any third-party tracking, marketing, or analytics cookies. Your use of Princeps is not tracked for advertising purposes or shared with external services.

sections.heading: Opt-Out
sections.content: Since we use only technically necessary cookies, a full opt-out is not possible without affecting core app functionality. You can manage or delete cookies at any time in your browser settings.

metadata.title: Security
metadata.description: How Princeps protects your data and how to report security issues.

sections.heading: Data Encryption
sections.content: All data is transmitted using TLS 1.2 or higher. Passwords are stored exclusively as cryptographic hashes — never in plaintext.

sections.heading: Access Control
sections.content: Each user has access exclusively to their own data. Access controls are enforced server-side. Delivery of other users' data is systemically excluded.

sections.heading: Backups
sections.content: Regular automated backups protect your data against loss. In the event of a technical issue, backed-up data states are available for recovery.

sections.heading: Security Incidents
sections.content: In the event of a security incident that could affect your data, affected users will be notified promptly — in accordance with GDPR requirements (Art. 33–34).

sections.heading: Reporting Vulnerabilities
sections.content: If you discover a security vulnerability in Princeps, please report it responsibly to security@princeps.app. We confirm receipt within 72 hours and work on a resolution promptly.
